tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

tools.name: list-files
tools.description: List files and folders in Google Drive. Supports filtering by folder, file type, and search query.

folderId.description: Optional: List files within a specific folder (use folder ID)

query.description: Optional: filename match (Drive `name contains`: prefix/token, e.g. 'Hello' matches 'HelloWorld' but 'World' does not). NOT a raw Drive query — for owner/date/fullText filters use `driveQuery`.

pageSize.description: Optional: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)

driveQuery.description: Optional advanced: a raw Google Drive API v3 query clause, AND-ed with the other filters. Use for filters `query` can't express, e.g. "not 'me' in owners", "modifiedTime > '2024-01-01T00:00:00'", "fullText contains 'budget'". Inside a literal, escape a single quote as \' (Drive syntax, NOT '' ) — for a plain filename match prefer the `query` param, which escapes for you.

tools.name: get-file
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific file or folder.

fileId.description: The ID of the file or folder to get information about

tools.name: download-file
tools.description: Download a file from Google Drive.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to download

outputPath.description: Optional: Local path to save the file (default: current directory)

tools.name: upload-file
tools.description: Upload a local file to Google Drive. By default the file is stored as-is with its real type. Pass convertTo to import it as a native Google file (e.g. an HTML/Word file → editable Google Doc).

filePath.description: Local path of the file to upload

parentFolderId.description: Optional: ID of the folder to upload to (default: root)

fileName.description: Optional: Custom name for the file (default: original filename)

convertTo.description: Optional: convert the upload into a native Google file. "document" (e.g. from HTML/Word/Markdown) → editable Google Doc; "spreadsheet" (from CSV/Excel) → Google Sheet; "presentation" (from PPTX) → Google Slides. Omit to keep the original format.

tools.name: create-document
tools.description: Create a native, editable Google Doc from text content. Pass the body as HTML (default, best formatting), Markdown, or plain text — Drive converts it into a real Google Doc, NOT an .html file. Use this to author documents; use upload-file only for existing local files.

title.description: Title (file name) of the new Google Doc

content.description: The document body. Interpreted according to contentType.

contentType.description: How to interpret content: "html" (default, richest formatting), "markdown", or "text" (plain). Drive converts it to a native Google Doc.

parentFolderId.description: Optional: ID of the folder to create the doc in (default: root)

tools.name: create-folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in Google Drive.

name.description: Name of the folder to create

parentFolderId.description: Optional: ID of the parent folder (default: root)

tools.name: delete-file
tools.description: Delete a file or folder from Google Drive.

fileId.description: The ID of the file or folder to delete

tools.name: share-file
tools.description: Share a file or folder with specific permissions.

fileId.description: The ID of the file or folder to share

tools.name: search-files
tools.description: Search for files in Google Drive by name, content, or properties.

searchTerm.description: Filename match (Drive `name contains`: prefix/token, not substring). For advanced filters (owners, dates, fullText) use the list-files `driveQuery` parameter.

tools.name: move-file
tools.description: Move a file or folder to a different location in Google Drive.

fileId.description: ID of the file/folder to move

tools.name: copy-file
tools.description: Create a copy of a file in Google Drive.

fileId.description: ID of the file to copy

tools.name: get-file-content
tools.description: Get the plain-text content of a Google Doc or text file. Does NOT extract text from binary files (PDF, Word, etc.) — for those, download the file and use the file-processor "file-to-markdown" tool.

fileId.description: ID of the file to read

mimeType.description: Optional: Export MIME type for Google Docs (e.g., 'text/plain', 'text/html')

tools.name: list-comments
tools.description: List all comments on a file.

pageSize.description: Optional: Maximum number of comments to return (default: 100)

tools.name: get-comment
tools.description: Get a specific comment by ID.

tools.name: create-comment
tools.description: Create a comment on a file.

fileId.description: ID of the file to comment on

content.description: The text content of the comment

tools.name: update-comment
tools.description: Update the content of a comment.

commentId.description: ID of the comment to update

tools.name: delete-comment
tools.description: Delete a comment.

commentId.description: ID of the comment to delete

tools.name: create-reply
tools.description: Create a reply to a comment. Can also be used to resolve a comment.

commentId.description: ID of the comment to reply to

action.description: Optional: Action to perform. Use 'resolve' to resolve the comment.

tools.name: list-replies
tools.description: List all replies to a comment.

pageSize.description: Optional: Maximum number of replies to return (default: 100)
